children: Comex gold futures might rise toward $4,600 an ounce, based on technical analysis, StoneX's Matt Simpson says in commentary. Support has been found around the 200-day exponential moving average and the weekly volume point of control, the senior market analyst notes. "A small bullish candle shows that bears lost steam around that support level," Simpson says. Also, "above-average volume relative to the small-range day suggests a 'change of hands' from bears to bulls," he says. "I am on guard for at least a cheeky bounce towards $4,600" an ounce, Simpson adds. Spot gold is 0.4% higher at $4,411.83 an ounce. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
